title: Partition Labels
summary: Split the string into as many nonempty contiguous pieces as possible, with all copies of each letter confined to one piece.
statement: Split the string into as many nonempty contiguous pieces as possible, with all copies of each letter confined to one piece. Return the piece lengths in order.

examples.explanation: Both a letters stay together, and c can stand alone.
The two a letters force one piece.

hints: Conceptual: A cut cannot separate two copies of a letter.
Directional: The last occurrence of a letter gives a lower bound on the current piece’s end.
Implementation: Extend the end for every letter you encounter. Cut when the scan reaches that end.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space excluding the output.
